hints: Notice that nums2 has exactly one extra element compared to nums1. That extra element must be produced by an append operation.
Suppose we choose index j in nums1 to append. Then nums1[j] must eventually become both nums2[j] and nums2.back().
The cost for index j is: adjust nums1[j] so that one copy matches nums2[j] and the appended copy matches nums2.back().
For each j, compute this adjustment cost, add the cost of transforming all other positions, and take the minimum.
